assets.title: Fir Tree01 — tree C
assets.author: Rico Cilliers (model), Rob Tuytel (photographs)
modifications: Extracted the single C tree from the original Poly Haven mesh collection (source505,494triangles).
Preserved bark,twig and trunk geometry, original vertex colour, normal, albedo and ARM materials.
Reduced geometry to29,231triangles with glTF Transform4.5.1 and0.3% error bound; quantized vertex attributes for web delivery.
Pruned unused mesh data and materials; recoded1K texture maps to WebP90 quality without resizing.
Packed original twig diffuse plus original twig alpha into RGBA; enabled alpha masking at0.38 with double-sided leaves.
Original C-trunk primitive lacked TEXCOORD_0 despite textured material: added continuous cylindrical UVs with wrapped seam vertices.
Unavailable trunk B diffuse and ARM files were substituted with already downloaded trunk A diffuse/ARM in extracted source. These materials are unused by tree C and were pruned from final file.
No Draco or meshopt decoder is required.

validation.warning: PBR normal maps use runtime-generated tangent space in Three.js.
